title: Two life-cycle forms
hook: One life cycle can include different forms.

knows: Animals can have structures and life stages that differ from humans.
doesNotKnow: One panel shows an attached polyp and the other a free-swimming medusa. Some jellyfish life cycles include both, with intermediate stages omitted here; the diagram does not describe every jellyfish species.

misconception: The observations in this scenario require a different interpretation.
objective: In the life cycle of some jellyfish, which form lives attached to a surface?
